'''Quermia''' was a [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] species. It was located near the end of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
About [[17,000 BBY]],<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|III|62|Quermia}}</ref> during the [[Indecta Era]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]] terraformed the planet into a veritable paradise.<ref name="CE" /> Then, they settled [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] subjects from the neighboring planet [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] on Quermia for a genetic experiment. These Xexto became the Quermians. Sometime later, the Arkanians moved on and forgot the world. Troiken and Quermia were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at about the same time, and their inhabitants at first designated Troiken Xexto and Quermian Xexto respectively. The Xexto were at first in denial at being related to the Quermians, and were later outraged when they learned of the Arkanian deception. The two planets joined the Republic at the same time.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Quermia was part of [[Xim's empire]] before its collapse. Around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], Quermia was located within space controlled by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Quermia was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Quermians were forced to remain in seclusion on their homeworld due to the connections of many of them with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. They eventually rejoined the galactic community during the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" />
